sentences.english_text: The men, carrying their suitcases, loaded with money and gold and silver, started out of the vault.
The suitcases had been light coming in, but now they were so heavy that the men could hardly carry them.
What do I do now?
I'm a criminal.
The police will keep hunting for me until they find me.
My life is ruined.
At that moment, there were the sounds of sirens all around the bank.
Well, talk about panic!
It's the police!
Someone must have tipped them off.
Let's get out of here!
The men started running toward the front door of the bank.
But as they reached it, Drippy peered out through the beard and could see that the street was filled with policemen.
We're gonna have to shoot our way out!
And to Drippy's horror, all the men pulled out their guns and began shooting at the policemen.
The gun sounded like cannons to Drippy's ears.
He had never heard such a loud noise in his life.
The war between the red ants and the black ants was nothing compared to this.
The police were shooting at the bank robbers, and the bank robbers were shooting at the police.
And it sounded like a war was going on.
Two of the bank robbers lay on the floor wounded, and the others realized that there was no escape for them.
The man with the beard threw down his gun, raising his hands in the air, and said, We give up!
Put your hands on top of your heads and walk out the door.
One of the policemen called.
The men walked out into the street.
You're under arrest.
A policeman told the man with the beard.
He put handcuffs on him.
You're going to jail for the rest of your life.
So am I, thought poor Drippy.
My life is over.
